limitations: Changes no behaviour; every exit code, printed line and stream stays byte-identical in the implementation commit.
The corpus pins observable behaviour, not intent; recorded defects are pinned on purpose.
Nothing shipped re-measures the corpus as the function later changes; GH #445 is a worked instance in this file.
The razor file clause moves further from compliance and was already violated before this phase.
Re-derivation commands assume a POSIX shell; this repository's primary environment is PowerShell.
non_goals: Fixing anything. GH #443, #425, #430 and the missing attestation paths remain untouched.
Extracting the entry-parsing loop at ledger_hash.py lines 241, 509, 642 and 735.
Unifying _post_anchor_classify with _classify_entry, a behaviour change belonging to the parity phase.
exclusions: Any change to governance_health, seal_entry_check, ledger_upgrade, qor/cli.py or pyproject.toml.

phases: Phase 1: ship the fixture corpus as tests/post_anchor_corpus.py including a legacy_chain_hash fixture for the acceptance branch 119 live ledger entries depend on, land it with inlined literal goldens in a first commit, then decompose verify_post_anchor into five helpers with _post_anchor_classify delegating to the shipped _resolve_recorded and the GH #363 label check moved to the caller; razor compliance under a stated counting rule, per-helper behaviour, delegation via an argument-asserting spy, and the boundary-zero identity check are all asserted by shipped tests rather than by figures in the plan
method_note: Iteration 5: every command quoted in the plan was executed against the working tree before the plan was written, including the re-derivation command iteration 4 published without running.
